newsitem.title: USA: Chevron brings El Segundo, CA cat back up.
newsitem.headline: Chevron brings El Segundo, CA cat back up.

text.p: Chevron Corp restored its 69,000 barrel per day (bpd) catalytic cracking unit at its El Segundo, Calif., refinery last weekend after several weeks of planned work on the unit.
"It came back up over the weekend," a Chevron spokeswoman told Reuters late Tuesday.
The return of the unit was, meanwhile, not welcomed by traders who are lamenting what they describe as a poor refining profit margin scene currently in California.
The refinery has crude distillation capacity of 230,000 bpd, according to National Petroleum Refiners Association.
